rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides direct integration with Frida on rooted Android devices for mobile penetration testing workflows. The server runs on the Android device itself using Termux and connects to a remote Frida server, enabling process management, application control, and dynamic instrumentation. Supports spawning applications, creating interactive sessions, executing JavaScript instrumentation code, and performing real-time method hooking. Includes automatic code compilation via esbuild for Frida 17 compatibility, making it useful for bypassing security controls like root detection mechanisms.
